Resolve Thermal Time Configuration for SEIR

Source: R/seir.R
dot-resolve_thermal_time.Rd

This function centralizes logic for:

  • enforcing that thermal_time is supplied when age_driver = "dvs";

  • validating infection_window structure when provided; and

  • constructing a fallback thermal_time list from infection_window (base_temp, gdd_to_maturity) when possible.

Usage

.resolve_thermal_time(age_driver, thermal_time, infection_window)

Arguments

age_driver

Character scalar. Age basis used by seir(); expected values are "day" or "dvs".

thermal_time

NULL or a list of thermal accumulation parameters. Expected fields are:

  • base_temp (numeric scalar)

  • gdd_to_maturity (numeric scalar > 0)

infection_window

NULL or a list defining a DVS infection gate. Must include:

  • dvs_start

  • dvs_end Optionally may include:

  • base_temp

  • gdd_to_maturity

Value

A thermal_time list (possibly unchanged input, or derived from infection_window) or NULL when not needed.

Details

Internal helper that validates and resolves thermal-time inputs required by seir() when using development stage (age_driver = "dvs") and/or an infection-window constraint.

Error Conditions

Aborts when:

  • age_driver = "dvs" and thermal_time is NULL;

  • infection_window is malformed (missing dvs_start/dvs_end);

  • infection_window is used to supply thermal-time values but is missing base_temp and/or gdd_to_maturity.

See also

seir(), .calculate_dvs()
